원자료 R00411의 적용 맥락: Using Israeli data from roughly 1979–1996 (Labour Force Survey and population registry), the paper studies Ultra‑Orthodox Jewish individuals and households in Israel, exploiting variation by ethnic origin (Sephardi vs Ashkenazi) and over time around large public‑policy shifts (subsidies, yeshiva stipends, draft deferments, child allowances; major political changes in 1977 and 1984). Main analyses evaluate how government transfers and exemptions affect yeshiva attendance, labor supply, and fertility within this institutional setting.
